But Brent rose to $112.02, HY OAS widened to 3.33%, and VIX is back up to 18.14. Equities are bouncing while oil and credit are not confirming. - **Option price against actual movement.** TQQQ ATM IV is 60% against a 3×VXN estimate of about 73%. The VXN-based shortcut runs hot. IV/HV is 1.28, so options are priced above what TQQQ has actually moved.

Spot is 7.7% above the 4-week low ($67.43), far from the 30% needed for RALLY (about $87.66). The VXN leg of DOWNTURN is no longer met (24.42 < 25).
- Trend: Mixed. Spot is 2.4% under the 50DMA ($74.40) and about 12.1% above the 200DMA (about $64.77). It is 17.2% under the 52-week high.
- Volatility & premium environment: VXN is 24.42, down from 25.22. The chain gives ATM IV of 60%, below the 73% a 3×VXN shortcut implies, so the shortcut is running about 20% hot. IV/HV 1.28 means premium is rich against actual movement. SKEW at 160.40 says downside protection is still expensive. TQQQ moves about 3 times the Nasdaq-100, so swings stay large.
- Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS. Premium is richer than realized movement (IV/HV 1.28), and VXN and VVIX are lower than last read. Against that, TQQQ is still under its 50DMA, NDX is not confirmed back above 30,000, high-yield credit is through its warning line, Brent is at $112, and the FOMC decision on Oct 28 falls inside the next 5 sessions. The rise of 3.1% on 10-21 has not yet been confirmed by a second day.
